patterns.note: Full-bleed image sections dominate the page, often featuring a single large image or a pair of images, with minimal surrounding whitespace.
Work titles are presented in large, bold, uppercase sans-serif text, centered over the imagery, creating a strong visual statement.
The user interface elements (text, navigation, footer) are strictly monochrome (black and white), allowing the vibrant photography to provide all the color.
A minimalist header bar with navigation links remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site sections.
Each portfolio entry is treated as a distinct, full-width visual block, separated by the natural scroll flow rather than explicit dividers or background changes.

technique_notes: A sticky header bar maintains its position at the top of the viewport, offering persistent navigation without obscuring content significantly.
Content sections are presented as full-width image blocks, often with large, centered text overlays, creating an immersive, gallery-like experience.

The site uses a standard vertical scroll to reveal new content sections, with no complex scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects on the main content, relying on the visual impact of the imagery.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, lighter body/credit text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all elements, including images and input fields, contributing to a crisp, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing around large image blocks and between text elements, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing the imagery to breathe.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism, allowing the high-quality, full-bleed photography to be the absolute focal point. The navigation and textual information are stripped down to the bare essentials, creating an immersive, gallery-like experience that prioritizes visual impact over descriptive text.
